dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - May 30, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Home Run Heroes Shine on Opening Day**

The Boston Red Sox crushed the Cleveland Guardians 9-1 behind Jarren Duran's 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a 9th-inning homer to seal the win. Duran drove in 3 runs, while Sonny Gray pitched 6 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

In another one-run game, the Los Angeles Angels annihilated the Tampa Bay Rays 14-3. Wade Meckler homered and drove in 4 runs, while Reid Detmers pitched 5 innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

The Atlanta Braves edged the Cincinnati Reds 5-2 thanks to Ronald Acuña Jr.'s 2-home run performance, propelling him to the top of the home run leaderboard. Martín Pérez earned the win, while Raisel Iglesias earned the save.

The Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the Los Angeles Dodgers 4-3 in a thrilling matchup, with Edmundo Sosa homering and driving in 2 runs. Roki Sasaki pitched 5.1 strong innings for the Dodgers, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.
